response.sql: WITH media_rates AS (SELECT mt.Name, COUNT(*) AS track_count, SUM(t.Bytes) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(t.Milliseconds), 0) AS byte_rate FROM MediaType AS mt JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId GROUP BY mt.Name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(byte_rate) AS avg_byte_rate FROM media_rates) SELECT AVG(r.byte_rate) AS avg_byte_rate, AVG(r.track_count) AS avg_track_count, AVG(r.byte_rate - o.avg_byte_rate) AS avg_excess_byte_rate FROM media_rates AS r CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE r.byte_rate > o.avg_byte_rate

assumptions.assumption: SUM ignores NULL Bytes; a group with no calculable rate is excluded from the averages.
